messages:
emily_cs: Heads up — GreenWave (pilot) just flagged they need per-route cost breakdowns from the Console for procurement before renewal. Meeting with them tomorrow, can we capture the asks and any quick unblock?

sam_product: Thanks Emily. Do we have a screenshot or exact ask text? @emily_cs did they specify CSV export vs UI tile?

emily_cs: Pasting the quote from their PM: 'We need per-route token & compute cost exported weekly. Current per-tenant rollup masks product usage and blocks procurement.' Screenshot attached in thread.

jake_sales: This looks like a renewal risk if procurement can't justify spend. Short-term: one-off CSV export + manual attach to procurement. Long-term: UI per-route cost.

rajesh_success: I can assemble a sample CSV by EOD. Is there an agreed CSV schema? cc: @sam_product for column names.

emily_cs: CSV columns they asked for: route_id, route_name, tokens_in, tokens_out, compute_ms, cost_estimate, week_start. Also include model_name and quantization_flag if available.

sam_product: Noted. I'm adding this to triage board with tags customer_ask, pilot, renewal_risk. Product priority = P2 unless sales flags higher.

triage-bot: Created ticket CS-5123: 'GreenWave per-route cost export' assigned to @rajesh_success. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5123

linda_devops: For a quick unblock I can run a query against the usage table and generate the CSV: `SELECT route, sum(tokens_in) as tokens_in, sum(tokens_out) as tokens_out, sum(compute_ms) as compute_ms FROM route_usage WHERE customer_id = 123 GROUP BY route;` I can add a cost_estimate column afterwards.

emily_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks Linda — include compute_ms estimate and a short note about quantization variance affecting cost.

sam_product: Quick product question: do we want to ship an export endpoint (API) or surface per-route cost in Console? Thoughts @linda_devops @jake_sales

linda_devops: Surfacing in Console requires UI work + aggregation logic + pagination/rate limits — estimate ~2 sprints. Export endpoint PoC = ~3 days (auth + csv).

jake_sales: Given renewal timeline (~2 weeks), export endpoint + one-off CSV to procurement is fine. Recommend Product scope UI work for Q3.

emily_cs: Action items: 1) Rajesh to attach sample CSV to CS-5123 by EOD. 2) Linda to produce export endpoint PoC by Thursday. 3) Sam to file Product spec for Q3 Console tile. I'll communicate status to GreenWave and procurement.

sam_product: :white_check_mark: I'll draft the spec and include the note 'show estimated cost using customer's current pricing profile; flag quantization/throughput variance.'

rajesh_success: Uploaded sample CSV to CS-5123 (small sample rows included).

emily_cs: Thanks team. Leaving this thread pinned to the account for audit. If GreenWave asks for a temporary discount, ping me before committing anything.

linda_devops: FYI I'll include a column `est_cost_using_rate` and add a README for the CSV schema.

emily_cs: Perfect, closing loop for now — will update after tomorrow's call with GreenWave.
